Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months. I know what's best for you 🤝.

JACK:
(getting up from the bed) I don't need you! I can take care of myself! 💪

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, sit back down. I'm not going to argue with you. You're going to take your medication, and that's final 💯.

Jack refuses to budge, and Dr. Smith is forced to take matters into his own hands 🤔. He reaches for the pills on his desk and forces Jack to take them, holding his hand until the pills are swallowed 💊.

As Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he's met with an empty space where Jack once sat 🤯. The room is quiet, except for the sound of his own breathing 👂.

DR. SMITH:
(confused) Where's Jack? 🤔

He looks around the room, but there's no sign of his patient. Suddenly, it hits him - the pills, the medication, the whole thing... it was all just a product of his own paranoid delusions 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(panicked) Oh no... oh no, no, no... 🚨

As the reality sets in, Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror, and he realizes that he's been the one who's been delusional all along 🤪. The pills, the medication, the whole thing... it was all just a manifestation of his own schizophrenia 💥.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
